glosses: Any of various easily-melted alloys, commonly of tin and lead, that are used to mend, coat, or join metal objects, usually small.

examples.text: ...the packaging of electronic components has moved from technology that used solder predominantly as an electrical connection (plated through-hole) to technology that uses solder as both a mechanical and electrical connection (surface mount technology)...
I've had so little feeling that I've burned myself with liquid solder and watched my skin burn and not felt anything.

glosses: Figuratively, circumstances or emotions that strongly bond things or persons together in analogy to solder that joins metals.

examples.text: Friendship! Mysterious cement of the soul — and solder of society.
